title: Quasi-periodic Dynamics for Multi-dimensional Quasi-linear Schrödinger Equations via Resonant Mode Control
summary: This paper focuses on the problem of quasi-periodic solutions for multi-dimensional quasi-linear Schrödinger equation. To address the challenge of unbounded perturbations caused by quasi-linear terms in the equation, we define the resonant mode set $\mathcal{K}$ to control nonlinear resonant effects. Combining KAM (Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser) ( or Nash-Moser ) theory and Fourier analysis methods, we prove that there are plenty of quasi-periodic solutions of the equation. We also present the Fourier expansion form of the solutions and the estimation of frequency shifts.
